perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: revenueDiversification
factors.basis: Serve reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.2 million, up 404% year over year, with recurring revenue above 50% of total revenue and DoorDash-derived revenue nearly 50% higher sequentially.

factors.name: liquidity
factors.basis: Serve ended Q2 2026 with $240.4 million of cash and marketable securities.

risks: Absolute revenue remains small relative to liquidity and deployment ambitions; equity count was approximately 86 million shares at June 30, 2026.
contradictions: Revenue growth and diversification improved while management simultaneously cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $9-$10 million because Uber Eats delivery volume was below expectations and projected second-half demand was removed.
unknowns: The release does not provide partner-level unit economics or a path from current revenue scale to sustained profitability.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: guidanceExecution
factors.basis: Management revised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $9-$10 million after lower-than-expected Uber Eats delivery volume, despite strong year-over-year reported growth and diversification into recurring healthcare, advertising and software revenue.

risks: Partner demand concentration and utilization can cause deployed fleet capacity to under-monetize.
contradictions: DoorDash momentum and recurring revenue diversification partially offset, but do not erase, the Uber Eats demand shortfall.
unknowns: Magnitude and duration of Uber Eats volume weakness beyond the revised guidance window are unknown.

sources.origin: Serve Robotics Investor Relations / Q2 2026 results
facts: Q2 revenue was $3.2 million, up 404% year over year and 9% sequentially.
Recurring revenue exceeded 50% of total revenue.
DoorDash partnership revenue grew nearly 50% sequentially.
Cash and marketable securities were $240.4 million at June 30, 2026.
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was revised to $9-$10 million due to lower-than-expected Uber Eats delivery volume and removal of projected second-half demand.
Approximately 86 million common shares were outstanding at June 30, 2026.

result: Fresh primary-source revenue, liquidity and guidance-execution evidence packaged for Alpha; no numeric underwriting assigned.
